/-!
# Erdős Problem 221

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/221](https://www.erdosproblems.com/221)
- [Lo54] Lorentz, G. G., *On a problem of additive number theory*. Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. (1954), 838-841.
- [Ru72] Ruzsa, Jr., I., *On a problem of P. Erdős*. Canad. Math. Bull. (1972), 309-310.
-/

open Filter Asymptotics

namespace Erdos221

/--
Is there a set $A\subset\mathbb{N}$ such that, for all large $N$,
$$\lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert \ll N/\log N$$
and such that every large integer can be written as $2^k+a$ for some
$k\geq 0$ and $a\in A$?

Lorentz [Lo54] proved there is such a set with, for all large $N$,
$$\lvert A\cap\{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert \ll \frac{\log\log N}{\log N}N$$
The answer is yes, proved by Ruzsa [Ru72].
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 11, formal_proof using lean4 at "https://github.com/Woett/Lean-files/blob/main/ErdosProblem221.lean"]
theorem erdos_221 :
    answer(True) ↔ ∃ A : Set ℕ,
      ((fun N => ({a ∈ A | a ≤ N}.ncard : ℝ)) ≪ (fun N => (N : ℝ) / Real.log N)) ∧
      ∀ᶠ N in atTop, ∃ k a, 0 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ A ∧ N = 2 ^ k + a := by
  sorry

end Erdos221

reformulations.difference: Lean counts all a ∈ A with a ≤ N, including a possible 0, whereas the source counts A ∩ {1,…,N}.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Both counting sets are finite. Writing their counts as c₀(N) and c₁(N), respectively, c₁(N) ≤ c₀(N) ≤ c₁(N)+1. For N ≥ 2, N/log N ≥ 1, so a source bound with constant C gives the Lean bound with constant C+1; the reverse follows from c₁ ≤ c₀. The eventual big-O condition also agrees with explicit positive constants and thresholds because both functions are eventually nonnegative. Review221.full_source_iff in /workspace/review/scratch.lean proves the equivalence of the complete existential properties, including the representation condition, without using the problem theorem.

sources_consulted: Ruzsa, Jr., I., On a problem of P. Erdős, Canadian Mathematical Bulletin 15 (1972), 309–310. https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/aop-cambridge-core/content/view/802ABD868A907C2ADB78C580C73C86FC/S0008439500061348a.pdf/on-a-problem-of-p-erdos.pdf

Lorentz, G. G., On a problem of additive number theory, Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society 5 (1954), 838–841. https://www.ams.org/journals/proc/1954-005-05/S0002-9939-1954-0063389-3/S0002-9939-1954-0063389-3.pdf
